episode.title: Preserve required tool-call correlation IDs when converting versioned model histories
episode.before: At parent 786c76cb76bea452fa7287cc1014c4a3d3cad2b1, the shared message converter included function-call and function-response IDs only when requiresToolCallId(model.id) recognized two non-Gemini model-name prefixes. Version-3 Gemini model IDs were not recognized, so conversion omitted the stored tool-call ID from both the outbound functionCall and its corresponding functionResponse. The existing test context contained tool calls but no tool results and therefore did not detect the broken call/result correlation.
episode.after: At cbaca60389f5d7097a43c95f56a19d344ecf2195, requiresToolCallId parses the Gemini major version and returns true for recognized Gemini versions 3 or newer, while retaining the existing prefix cases. The unchanged conversion call sites consequently emit the same stored ID on both functionCall and functionResponse objects for Gemini 3 histories. Tests cover two Google API variants, multiple Gemini 3 IDs, omission for Gemini 2.5, and preservation of the previously supported model families.
episode.diff: The implementation adds a Gemini-major-version branch to the central tool-call-ID requirement predicate. The tests add matching tool-result messages, assert end-to-end preservation of call_1 and call_2 on both sides of the function-call contract, assert that Gemini 2.5 still omits IDs, and directly test the predicate boundary and existing prefix cases. No serializer duplication or unrelated conversion behavior was changed.

evidence_units.claim: Commit cbaca60389f5d7097a43c95f56a19d344ecf2195 is an implementation-bearing fix titled "fix(ai): preserve Gemini 3 tool call IDs (#7494)", has parent 786c76cb76bea452fa7287cc1014c4a3d3cad2b1, and modifies the shared converter and its focused test.

evidence_units.claim: Before the change, requiresToolCallId returned true only for model IDs beginning with claude- or gpt-oss-, excluding Gemini 3 model IDs.
The change reuses getGeminiMajorVersion and extends requiresToolCallId to return true when a recognized Gemini major version is at least 3, while retaining both existing prefix conditions.
Assistant tool calls conditionally copy block.id into functionCall.id using requiresToolCallId(model.id).
evidence_units.source: git show cbaca60389f5d7097a43c95f56a19d344ecf2195:packages/ai/src/api/google-shared.ts, convertMessages assistant toolCall branch

evidence_units.claim: Tool results conditionally copy msg.toolCallId into functionResponse.id using the same requiresToolCallId(model.id) decision, keeping request and response correlation behavior aligned.
The updated history fixture contains two tool calls and their two corresponding tool results, with matching IDs call_1 and call_2.
Parameterized conversion tests assert that both functionCall IDs and functionResponse IDs equal ["call_1", "call_2"] for two Gemini 3 model IDs and for both supported Google API variants.

evidence_units.claim: A direct predicate test expects false for gemini-2.5-flash and true for gemini-3.6-flash, claude-sonnet-4-5, and gpt-oss-120b.
The parent test fixture ended after the assistant tool-call message and had no assertions over function-response IDs, so it could not validate call/result identifier correlation.

candidate_atomics.name: classify-protocol-variants-requiring-correlation-ids
candidate_atomics.description: Extend the shared capability decision so every structured-message variant that requires explicit correlation identifiers causes both calls and results to serialize the same stored ID, without adding IDs to older variants.

semantic_action.intent: Prevent loss of tool-call/result correlation when replaying histories through protocol variants that require explicit identifiers.
semantic_action.module_role: Structured-message protocol capability classifier used by the outbound history adapter
semantic_action.pre_state: A versioned model family requires explicit function-call and function-response IDs, but the shared requirement predicate does not recognize that version, so both serializer branches omit their stored identifiers.
semantic_action.post_state: The requirement predicate recognizes the affected major-version boundary; both call and result serializer branches emit matching stored identifiers for recognized variants, while older variants continue to omit them.
semantic_action.validation: Use a paired history containing multiple tool calls and matching results; assert exact IDs on every serialized call and response, assert omission below the version boundary, and assert that previously recognized families remain recognized.

candidate_workflows.name: restore-structured-call-result-correlation-at-a-version-boundary
candidate_workflows.description: Repair a shared structured-message adapter when a newly supported protocol version needs explicit correlation IDs but the central capability predicate excludes it.

workflow_graph.goal: Ensure serialized tool calls and their results retain matching correlation identifiers exactly for protocol variants that require them.
workflow_graph.entry_state: Internal history contains paired tool-call and tool-result IDs, but conversion drops them for an unrecognized versioned protocol family.
workflow_graph.exit_state: Every serialized call and matching response retains its identifier for the affected version boundary; older versions still omit IDs and existing supported families remain unchanged.
